name: LAH FAMILY ORIENTAL AND SUSHI MART LLC

violations.description: Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Observed items in refrigerators and cold hold unit not date marked.
Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. -Observed soap dispenser by hand sink was empty.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room used by women did not contain at least one covered waste receptacle.
